question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"with."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"With"** is the most appropriate preposition to use in this context.
 
• We use **"with"** to refer to what we use to do something.
 
 
• **Example**:* They opened the package **with**__ a knife.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is **Option 1.**

**Correct passage**:

Dandelion is a widely distributed weed of the daisy family, __**with**__ a rosette of leaves and large bright yellow flowers followed ______ (2) ______ globular heads of seeds with downy tufts. I also reminded them that April is designated as the Month of ______ (3) ______ Military Child. Not many would know that 15 April is the day when we wear purple, or so to say, we ‘purple ______ (4) ______’ to express our solidarity and support ______ (5) ______ the strength and sacrifices of our children, while their fathers are deployed at Siachen Glacier, deserts and on our borders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2, "on"**, could be used if the blank referred to a specific date or time.
 
• **Option 3, "of"**, would not be appropriate in this context. 
 
• **Option 4, "within"**, could be used if the blank referred to a specific time frame.
